title: LVMH: The Wolf in Cashmere’s Conglomerate - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 68]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital Management.
reader_summary.overview: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital Management. Today we’re breaking down the world’s largest luxury business, LVMH. The LVMH story is deeply reflective of the vision of its 73 year-old founder and architect, Bernard Arnault.

key_points.text: Today, the business generates €75 billion in sales across its 75 brands and 3 sector focuses.
With a market cap of €350 billion.
To break down LVMH, I’m joined by Christian Billinger, the chairman of Billinger Förvaltnings.
